<script src="https://sdk.namastay.io/index.js"></script>
<script>
  (function() {
    var hotelParameters = {
      apiKey: 'a5c7bf15e6bd4b1e8d920c6b803ef0d6562ej4kbl00uqg9b',
      spreedlyApiKey: 'D1a8Zma8lZfap6nZpUjPxp6OHBV',
      widgetButtonsClass: 'namastay-widget-button',
      specialOfferButtonsClass: 'namastay-offer-button',
    };
    
    initNamastay(hotelParameters);
    
    // Track transformed elements - ES5 compatible
    var transformedInputs = [];
    var transformedLinks = [];
    var createdButtons = [];
    var lastCheckIn = '';
    var lastCheckOut = '';
    
    function extractRateCode(url) {
      try {
        var urlObj = new URL(url);
        var rateParam = urlObj.searchParams.get('Rate');
        return rateParam;
      } catch (e) {
        return null;
      }
    }
    
    function extractRoomId(url) {
      try {
        var urlObj = new URL(url);
        var roomParam = urlObj.searchParams.get('room');
        return roomParam;
      } catch (e) {
        return null;
      }
    }
    
    function getDateFromLabel(inputName) {
      var input = document.querySelector('input[name="' + inputName + '"]');
      if (!input) return null;
      
      // Find the label for this input
      var label = null;
      if (input.id) {
        label = document.querySelector('label[for="' + input.id + '"]');
      }
      
      // If no label found, try next sibling
      if (!label) {
        var sibling = input.nextElementSibling;
        if (sibling && sibling.tagName === 'LABEL') {
          label = sibling;
        }
      }
      
      // If still no label, try parent's next child
      if (!label && input.parentElement) {
        var parent = input.parentElement;
        for (var i = 0; i < parent.children.length; i++) {
          if (parent.children[i].tagName === 'LABEL') {
            label = parent.children[i];
            break;
          }
        }
      }
      
      if (!label) return null;
      
      // Extract date from spans
      var daySpan = label.querySelector('.datepicker_day');
      var monthYearSpan = label.querySelector('.datepicker_month_year');
      
      if (!daySpan || !monthYearSpan) return null;
      
      var day = daySpan.textContent.trim();
      var monthYear = monthYearSpan.textContent.trim(); // e.g., "Jan, 2026"
      
      // Parse month and year
      var parts = monthYear.split(',');
      if (parts.length !== 2) return null;
      
      var monthStr = parts[0].trim();
      var year = parts[1].trim();
      
      // Convert month name to number
      var monthMap = {
        'Jan': '01', 'Feb': '02', 'Mar': '03', 'Apr': '04',
        'May': '05', 'Jun': '06', 'Jul': '07', 'Aug': '08',
        'Sep': '09', 'Oct': '10', 'Nov': '11', 'Dec': '12'
      };
      
      var month = monthMap[monthStr];
      if (!month) return null;
      
      // Pad day with zero if needed
      if (day.length === 1) {
        day = '0' + day;
      }
      
      return year + '-' + month + '-' + day;
    }
    
    function getCheckInDate() {
      // Try input with id first (for regular date inputs)
      var inputById = document.querySelector('input#checkInDate');
      if (inputById && inputById.value && inputById.value !== 'Check In') {
        return inputById.value;
      }
      
      // Try datepicker with name attribute and get from label spans
      var dateFromLabel = getDateFromLabel('checkInDate');
      if (dateFromLabel) {
        return dateFromLabel;
      }
      
      return null;
    }
    
    function getCheckOutDate() {
      // Try input with id first (for regular date inputs)
      var inputById = document.querySelector('input#checkOutDate');
      if (inputById && inputById.value && inputById.value !== 'Check Out') {
        return inputById.value;
      }
      
      // Try datepicker with name attribute and get from label spans
      var dateFromLabel = getDateFromLabel('checkOutDate');
      if (dateFromLabel) {
        return dateFromLabel;
      }
      
      return null;
    }
    
    function getAdults() {
      // Try to get adults from various inputs
      var adultsInput = document.querySelector('input[name="adults"], input#adults, select[name="adults"], select#adults');
      if (adultsInput && adultsInput.value) {
        return parseInt(adultsInput.value);
      }
      return null;
    }
    
    function updateAllButtons() {
      var currentCheckIn = getCheckInDate();
      var currentCheckOut = getCheckOutDate();
      var currentAdults = getAdults();
      
      // Check if dates actually changed
      if (currentCheckIn === lastCheckIn && currentCheckOut === lastCheckOut) {
        return;
      }
      
      lastCheckIn = currentCheckIn;
      lastCheckOut = currentCheckOut;
      
      // Update all created buttons
      for (var i = 0; i < createdButtons.length; i++) {
        var btn = createdButtons[i];
        if (btn._updateData && document.body.contains(btn)) {
          btn._updateData();
        }
      }
      
      // Update all transformed links
      for (var j = 0; j < transformedLinks.length; j++) {
        var link = transformedLinks[j];
        if (link._updateData && document.body.contains(link)) {
          link._updateData();
        }
      }
    }

    function transformSynxisLinks() {
      // Handle links
      var allLinks = document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="?sbe_internalLink"], a[href*="?sbe_openBE"]');
      
      for (var i = 0; i < allLinks.length; i++) {
        var link = allLinks[i];
        
        // Skip if already transformed
        if (transformedLinks.indexOf(link) !== -1) {
          continue;
        }
        
        var href = link.getAttribute('href');
        
        if (href) {
          var rateCode = extractRateCode(href);
          var room = extractRoomId(href);
          var roomCode = link.getAttribute('data-room-code');
          
          link.setAttribute('href', 'javascript:void(0)');
          link.removeAttribute('target');
          link.removeAttribute('data-sbe_init');
          
          link.style.cursor = 'pointer';
          
          // Store metadata for updates
          link._rateCode = rateCode;
          link._room = room;
          link._roomCode = roomCode;
          
          // Create update function for this link
          link._updateData = (function(lnk) {
            return function() {
              var currentCheckIn = getCheckInDate();
              var currentCheckOut = getCheckOutDate();
              var currentAdults = getAdults();
              
              if (lnk._rateCode) {
                var offerData = { ratePlanCode: lnk._rateCode };
                if (lnk._roomCode) offerData.roomId = lnk._roomCode;
                if (currentCheckIn) offerData.startDate = currentCheckIn;
                if (currentCheckOut) offerData.endDate = currentCheckOut;
                if (currentAdults) offerData.adult = currentAdults;
                
                lnk.classList.add('namastay-offer-button');
                lnk.setAttribute('data-offer', JSON.stringify(offerData));
              } else if (lnk._room || lnk._roomCode) {
                var offerData = { roomId: lnk._roomCode || lnk._room };
                if (currentCheckIn) offerData.startDate = currentCheckIn;
                if (currentCheckOut) offerData.endDate = currentCheckOut;
                // Always include adult, default to 2 if not available
                offerData.adult = currentAdults || 2;
                
                lnk.classList.add('namastay-offer-button');
                lnk.classList.remove('book-btn');
                lnk.setAttribute('data-offer', JSON.stringify(offerData));
              } else {
                lnk.classList.add('namastay-widget-button');
              }
            };
          })(link);
          
          // Initial update
          link._updateData();
          
          // Mark as transformed
          transformedLinks.push(link);
        }
      }
      
      // Handle input buttons - transform to button elements
      var allInputs = document.querySelectorAll('input.skipper-be-cta, input[data-sbe_init="true"]');
      
      for (var j = 0; j < allInputs.length; j++) {
        var input = allInputs[j];
        
        // Skip if already transformed
        if (transformedInputs.indexOf(input) !== -1) {
          continue;
        }
        
        // Mark as transformed
        transformedInputs.push(input);
        
        // Create new button element
        var button = document.createElement('button');
        
        // Copy classes
        button.className = input.className;
        button.classList.remove('skipper-be-cta');
        
        // Copy ID if present
        if (input.id) {
          button.id = input.id;
        }
        
        // Copy button text from input value
        button.textContent = input.value || 'Check Availability';
        
        // Get initial data from input
        var roomCode = input.getAttribute('data-room-code');
        var checkIn = input.getAttribute('data-start-date');
        var checkOut = input.getAttribute('data-end-date');
        var adults = input.getAttribute('data-adults');
        
        // Store metadata on button for updates
        button._roomCode = roomCode;
        button._adults = adults;
        
        // Function to update button data
        button._updateData = (function(btn) {
          return function() {
            var currentCheckIn = getCheckInDate() || checkIn;
            var currentCheckOut = getCheckOutDate() || checkOut;
            var currentAdults = getAdults() || (btn._adults ? parseInt(btn._adults) : null);
            
            // If room code exists, always make it an offer button
            if (btn._roomCode) {
              var bookingData = { roomId: btn._roomCode };
              if (currentCheckIn) bookingData.startDate = currentCheckIn;
              if (currentCheckOut) bookingData.endDate = currentCheckOut;
              if (currentAdults) bookingData.adult = currentAdults;
              
              btn.setAttribute('data-offer', JSON.stringify(bookingData));
              btn.classList.remove('namastay-widget-button');
              btn.classList.add('namastay-offer-button');
            } else if (currentCheckIn || currentCheckOut || currentAdults) {
              // Has booking data but no room code
              var bookingData = {};
              if (currentCheckIn) bookingData.startDate = currentCheckIn;
              if (currentCheckOut) bookingData.endDate = currentCheckOut;
              if (currentAdults) bookingData.adult = currentAdults;
              
              btn.setAttribute('data-offer', JSON.stringify(bookingData));
              btn.classList.remove('namastay-widget-button');
              btn.classList.add('namastay-offer-button');
            } else {
              // No data at all - widget button
              btn.removeAttribute('data-offer');
              btn.classList.remove('namastay-offer-button');
              btn.classList.add('namastay-widget-button');
            }
          };
        })(button);
        
        // Initial data update
        button._updateData();
        
        button.style.cursor = 'pointer';
        button.style.textTransform = 'uppercase';
        
        // Replace input with button
        input.parentNode.replaceChild(button, input);
        
        // Store button reference
        createdButtons.push(button);
      }
      
      // Set up date picker listeners (only once)
      if (!window._datePickerListenersSetup) {
        window._datePickerListenersSetup = true;
        
        // Add event listeners for date inputs with id
        var checkInById = document.querySelector('input#checkInDate');
        var checkOutById = document.querySelector('input#checkOutDate');
        
        if (checkInById) {
          checkInById.addEventListener('change', updateAllButtons);
          checkInById.addEventListener('input', updateAllButtons);
        }
        if (checkOutById) {
          checkOutById.addEventListener('change', updateAllButtons);
          checkOutById.addEventListener('input', updateAllButtons);
        }
        
        // Polling - check every 500ms for date changes
        setInterval(updateAllButtons, 500);
      }
    }
    
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', transformSynxisLinks);
    } else {
      transformSynxisLinks();
    }
    
    setTimeout(transformSynxisLinks, 1000);
    setTimeout(transformSynxisLinks, 2000);
    setTimeout(transformSynxisLinks, 3000);
    setTimeout(transformSynxisLinks, 5000);
    
    // Simplified observer - only watches for new links being added
    var observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
      var hasNewLinks = false;
      
      for (var i = 0; i < mutations.length; i++) {
        if (mutations[i].type === 'childList' && mutations[i].addedNodes.length > 0) {
          for (var j = 0; j < mutations[i].addedNodes.length; j++) {
            var node = mutations[i].addedNodes[j];
            if (node.nodeType === 1) {
              // Check if it's a Synxis link
              if (node.tagName === 'A') {
                var href = node.getAttribute('href');
                if (href && (href.indexOf('?sbe_openBE') > -1 || href.indexOf('?sbe_internalLink') > -1)) {
                  hasNewLinks = true;
                  break;
                }
              }
              // Check if it contains Synxis links
              if (node.querySelector) {
                if (node.querySelector('a[href*="?sbe_openBE"]') || node.querySelector('a[href*="?sbe_internalLink"]')) {
                  hasNewLinks = true;
                  break;
                }
              }
            }
          }
          if (hasNewLinks) break;
        }
      }
      
      if (hasNewLinks) {
        // Debounce to prevent rapid successive calls
        clearTimeout(window._transformTimeout);
        window._transformTimeout = setTimeout(transformSynxisLinks, 100);
      }
    });
    
    observer.observe(document.body, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true
    });
    
  })();
</script>
